description: This file defines two interface types for Orleans grains related to version and placement tests. It includes conditional compilation for version attributes and declares methods for retrieving version info and performing tasks.

methods.name: GetVersion
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the version number of the grain.

methods.name: ProxyGetVersion
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the version from another grain instance.

methods.name: LongRunningTask
methods.description: Performs a long-running task for the specified duration.
